build.buildCommand: cd ../../ && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm turbo run build --filter=@yippie/app && cp -r apps/app/public apps/app/.next/standalone/public 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r apps/app/.next/static apps/app/.next/standalone/.next/static

deploy.startCommand: (cd apps/app && npx prisma migrate deploy) && node apps/app/.next/standalone/server.js
